The reader is not told it is the opposite-sign (inverse-direction) version obtained by conjugating input and output of F tilde, nor that its exact counterpart is R F_s^+ (paper lines 4478-4484), which is what the later claim that the three transforms give (u*v)/S^2 depends on.

Wrong exponent. Each stored operand carries the factor 2^{-b-2}, so the convolution u*v carries (2^{-b-2})^2 = 2^{-2b-4}. Multiplying by 2^{2b+4} cancels 2^{-2b-4}, not 2^{-b-2}. The paper (lines 4540 and 4719-4720) says 2^{2b+4} reverses the two input scalings.
